selection_rule: Youden J (max TPR-FPR), the balanced point. The FAR<=10% alternative was rejected: it refuses 33.6% of ANSWERABLE queries, which is an unusable product. Crucially the relevance gate is not the only defence - the output-side groundedness rail independently catches ungrounded answers - so tightening the input gate past the balanced point buys redundant safety at a large recall cost. All three operating points are published in docs/guardrails-eval.md so the trade is visible rather than asserted.
